purpose: Read-only implementation-fidelity review input, not a new Wayfinder, acceptance gate, software manifest or installation receipt.
scope: Six review desks: O:I integration plus five non-QL native owners. This does not redefine the six native products.
source_baseline_kind: Published main refs observed sequentially during setup; not certified as a compatible installed suite.

protected.QL-MEF: No internal source crawl, changes, branch reconciliation or new architecture specification. Inspect only non-QL owner declarations/consumer boundaries and already published non-QL planning references needed to identify a dependency. Mark deeper QL verification outside this commission.
protected.ui_and_app: Existing new parallel UI is the presentation destination; donor app functionality and active pushed UI branches may be read at exact refs. No edits, merges, resets, restarts or replacement UI.
protected.machines: No Mac/Omarchy installation, SSH work, host/sandbox mutation, credentials or service manipulation commissioned to these web reviewers. Local cut and live hardening crews continue independently.

cut_in_progress.policy: The native Mac cut is running separately. Do not claim its outcome or block review pending it. Audit these pinned published sources now. Record exact subsequent main/candidate/UI refs separately in each report; synthesis reconciles affected findings to the actual returned cut when available.

branch_policy.candidate_refs: Discover currently relevant pushed feature/integration/UI refs from live owner issues and branch/PR metadata. Resolve and record exact commit IDs before reading; read source, not only merge summaries. No unpublished local state is inferred.
branch_policy.main_vs_candidate: Report separately: pinned main; reviewed candidate; current source at final delta check; installed/running evidence when actually supplied. An unmerged repair is neither a missing implementation nor proof of installation.
branch_policy.cross_owner_comparison: State both producer and consumer revisions. Different valid version contracts are not automatically a defect; identify whether the proposed or installed combination actually composes them.

report_writes.allowed: Each reviewer writes only its assigned report and, if necessary, a matching -evidence.md annex in this directory. Synthesis writes only SYNTHESIS.md and ALIGNMENT.md here.
report_writes.publication: Main requires pull requests (observed 409 on direct create during setup). Use a narrowly scoped report-only publication branch from current main, native create/update with actual file SHAs, normal PR/checks and merge; read back the assigned file on main. No protection bypass. A report publication branch needs no local code worktree.
report_writes.shared_files: Reviewers must not change this baseline, the shared README, other reports, product code/tests, canonical plans/settings, or issue states.
report_writes.not_permitted: No fixes while auditing, no workflow dispatch or remote compute commissioning, no blind branch merge, and no private deployment data or secrets in committed reports.

follow_on_workspace_rule: Implementation uses an existing reusable code worktree per coherent feature/development line, not per reviewer, agent, session, finding or retry. Separate runtime sandboxes do not require duplicated source worktrees.
